title: Mapping Open-Source Agent Frameworks to the LW Loss-of-Control Kill Chain: Which Stages Lack Visibility?

original_idea.body:
# Mapping Open-Source Agent Frameworks to the LW Loss-of-Control Kill Chain: Which Stages Lack Visibility?

**Problem:** Popular open-source agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) were not designed with the LW loss-of-control kill chain in mind. No study has mapped their built-in logging/monitoring to which kill-chain stages they cover.

**Direction:** Take the LW threat matrix tactics (Discovery, Lateral Movement, Defense Evasion, Persistence, etc.) and systematically assess what telemetry each major open-source framework produces for each stage. Produce a gap matrix.

**Why it matters:** Developers using these frameworks have implicit security assumptions that may be entirely wrong. This study makes those assumptions explicit and actionable.

**Relevant context:** LW 2026 Loss of Control Threat Matrix; AutoGen/LangChain/CrewAI documentation.
